questions.text: Who assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) in May 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda

In News

  • Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May, 2026.

Key Points

  • Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda previously served as the Director (Finance) of the company and held the additional charge of Director (Commercial) for about nine months prior to this appointment.
  • He began his journey with SAIL in 1992 as a Management Trainee (Technical) after completing his B.E. in Electrical Engineering.
  • Over three decades, he has held diverse responsibilities across multiple plants, gaining extensive experience in operational, financial, and commercial domains, directly making him the correct appointee for the top leadership position.

Additional Information

  • During his tenure as Director (Finance), Dr. Panda spearheaded strategic initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency and profitability.
  • In his role as Director (Commercial), he focused on enhancing Net Sales Realisation (NSR), reducing inventory levels, and strengthening product branding.
  • He is widely respected as a people-centric leader with an inclusive leadership style and strong execution capabilities.

Important Points

  • Capacity Expansion: Upon assuming charge, Dr. Panda outlined that SAIL is on track for its next phase of capacity expansion to 35 MTPA.
  • Strategic Priorities: His immediate priorities for the company include placing the highest priority on safety across workplaces and strengthening raw material security through domestic mining and exploration of overseas assets.

questions.text: Which bank has partnered with Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M) to launch the first-of-its-kind sustainability-linked dealer financing program in the Indian automotive sector?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is DBS Bank India

In News

  • Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd (M&M) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with DBS Bank India to launch a sustainability-linked dealer financing program.

Key Points

  • The initiative is the first-of-its-kind in the Indian automotive sector, aimed at incentivizing authorized M&M dealers to adopt sustainable business practices.
  • Dealers will be offered favourable interest rates on loans for the purchase of passenger and commercial vehicles based on their environmental performance.
  • The program's criteria are aligned with M&M’s Green Dealership Program, monitoring parameters such as greenhouse gas emissions, water consumption, renewable energy use, and waste management.
  • Additional evaluation factors include the provision of Electric Vehicle (EV) charging facilities and the number of eSUVs sold by the dealership.

Additional Information

  • DBS Bank India was recognized as the Best Bank for Corporate Banking in India by Crisil Coalition Greenwich in both 2025 and 2026.
  • The bank also received the award for Best Bank for Sustainable Finance – India by Global Finance in 2024.
  • Mahindra & Mahindra secured a leadership position in the 2026 DJSI, S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook.

Important Points

  • The initiative supports the Indian Government’s Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) targets under the Paris Agreement to reach net-zero emissions by 2070.
  • The program framework allows dealership operations to be measured against specific sustainability parameters to ensure transparency and accountability.

questions.text: Which driver finished in the second position at the 2026 Japanese Grand Prix held at the Suzuka Circuit?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Oscar Piastri.

In News

  • Oscar Piastri of McLaren secured the second position at the Japanese Grand Prix 2026.

Key Points

  • Oscar Piastri (Australia), driving for McLaren, earned 18 points for his second-place finish.
  • The race was won by Kimi Antonelli, who became the youngest driver to lead the Formula 1 World Championship.
  • Charles Leclerc of Ferrari finished in third place, rounding out the podium.
  • Top 3 Finishers - Japanese GP 2026
    • 1st Place: Kimi Antonelli (Italy)
    • 2nd Place: Oscar Piastri (Australia)
    • 3rd Place: Charles Leclerc (Monaco)

Additional Information

  • Oscar Piastri
    • Nationality: Australian
    • Team: McLaren
    • Career Highlight: Known for his rapid rise through the junior categories (F3 and F2 champion).
  • Suzuka Circuit
    • Country: Japan
    • Design: Famous for its unique 'figure-eight' layout.
    • History: First utilized for F1 in 1963.
  • Championship Standing
    • Kimi Antonelli's win moved him to the top of the standings, making him the youngest leader in F1 history.

questions.text: Under which category did the ICMR-MINDS initiative receive the Gold Award at the National Awards for e-Governance 2026?

options.text: Excellence in Government Process Re-engineering for Digital Transformation
Innovation by Use of AI and Other New Age Technologies for Providing Citizen-Centric Services
Digital Transformation in Public Sector Undertakings
Outstanding Research on Citizen Centric Services by Research Institutions
Leveraging Blockchain Technology for Transparent Governance

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Innovation by Use of AI and Other New Age Technologies for Providing Citizen-Centric Services

In News

  • The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) initiative, ICMR-MINDS, was conferred the Gold Award at the National Awards for e-Governance 2026 held in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

Key Points

  • The ICMR-MINDS project received the award under Category 2, which is titled Innovation by Use of AI and Other New Age Technologies for Providing Citizen-Centric Services.
  • The initiative utilizes an AI-enabled digital platform and a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) to empower frontline healthcare workers in delivering standardized mental healthcare.
  • The platform allows for task-shifting, where non-specialist providers can perform screenings and routine management, reducing the dependence on limited specialists.
  • The award was presented by Dr Jitendra Singh, Union Minister of State for Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, during the 29th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG) 2026.

Additional Information

  • The National Awards for e-Governance are instituted by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).
  • The conference took place on July 1–2, 2026, in Jaipur, in the presence of various state and central dignitaries.
  • ICMR-MINDS is designed as an implementation research study to integrate mental and substance use disorder management with non-communicable diseases.

Important Points

  • The initiative is active across seven states: Assam, Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, and Punjab.
  • Collaborating institutions include AIIMS Guwahati, GIMH Ahmedabad, AIIMS New Delhi, St. John’s Medical College, AIIMS Bhopal, AIIMS Bhubaneswar, and PGIMER Chandigarh.
  • Key features of the platform include multilingual interfaces, offline functionality, and real-time administrative dashboards.

questions.text: Which platform has emerged as India's "One Nation, One Digital Platform" for school education, according to the recent announcement by the Centre?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is DIKSHA

In News

  • The Centre stated that the Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing (DIKSHA) has become India's "One Nation, One Digital Platform" for school education.

Key Points

  • DIKSHA: Launched in 2017, this platform is led by the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) and the Central Institute of Educational Technology (CIET). It provides digital resources linked to curricula for students from foundational literacy to senior secondary classes.
  • One Nation, One Digital Platform: The platform serves as a unified digital infrastructure adopted by almost all states and Union Territories to ensure continuity of learning.
  • Logic for Options:
    • NISHTHA: This refers to the National Initiative for School Heads' and Teachers' Holistic Advancement, which is a training programme for teachers hosted on the DIKSHA platform, but it is not the platform itself.
    • DAISY: Standing for Digital Accessible Information System, this is a specific digital format used on the platform to make materials accessible to differently-abled students.
    • CIET: The Central Institute of Educational Technology is an organization that collaborates with NCERT to lead DIKSHA, rather than being the platform name.

Additional Information

  • Content Variety: The platform hosts QR-coded Energised Textbooks, 2D/3D animations, augmented reality (AR) content, and Indian Sign Language videos.
  • Federated Model: DIKSHA allows states to customize and upload regional language content aligned with their specific curricula while CIET-NCERT manages quality checks.
  • Offline Accessibility: To ensure uninterrupted access, the platform allows for offline downloads and preloading on smart classroom boards.

Important Points

  • DIKSHA supports personalised learning through competency-based question banks, adaptive assessments, and detailed solutions.
  • It enables teachers to complete self-paced certified training modules online.

questions.text: As per the news report, what is the record surplus transfer declared by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to the government for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 (FY26)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs 2.87 lakh crore

In News

  • The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced a record dividend payout to the central government for FY26 to help manage economic pressures.

Key Points

  • The RBI declared a record surplus transfer of Rs 2.87 lakh crore to the government for FY26, providing a vital fiscal buffer amid rising energy prices.
  • Rs 2.69 lakh crore: This was the surplus transfer amount for the previous year (last year), which was 27% higher than its preceding year.
  • Rs 3.16 lakh crore: This was the total dividend receipt estimate mentioned in the Union Budget from state-owned enterprises and the central bank combined.
  • Rs 1.09 lakh crore: This is the specific amount the Central Board approved to be transferred to the Contingent Risk Buffer (CRB) for FY26, which is significantly higher than the Rs 44,861.70 crore transferred in the previous year.
  • The record surplus was primarily driven by foreign exchange gains (due to a 10% fall in the US dollar) and a 60% surge in gold prices during FY26.

Additional Information

  • The RBI’s balance sheet expanded by 20.61% to reach Rs 91.97 lakh crore as of March 31, 2026.
  • The gross income of the Reserve Bank rose by 26.42% compared to the previous year.
  • The Revised Economic Capital Framework (ECF) stipulates that the Contingent Risk Buffer (CRB) must be maintained within a range of 4.5% to 7.5% of the total balance sheet.

Important Points

  • Despite the record payout, economists suggest it may not be enough for the government to meet its fiscal deficit target of 4.3%.
  • The 10-year bond yield has climbed to 7.10%, and the rupee has weakened nearly 7% so far this year.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding Exercise Pitch Black 2026:

1. It is the Royal Australian Air Force’s (RAAF) premier and largest international air combat exercise.
2. The Indian Air Force (IAF) is scheduled to participate in the 2026 edition, which will be held in Australia’s Northern Territory.
3. The exercise is specifically designed to strengthen relationships exclusively among the four Quad member nations (India, Australia, Japan, and the USA).

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1 and 2 only

In News

  • The Indian Air Force (IAF) will participate in Exercise Pitch Black 2026, which was announced by the Australian High Commissioner to India, Philip Green OAM.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: Exercise Pitch Black is the Royal Australian Air Force’s (RAAF) largest international exercise and its premier multinational air combat exercise.
  • Statement 2 is correct: The IAF will participate in the exercise scheduled to be held in Australia’s Northern Territory from July 20 to August 7, 2026.
  • Statement 3 is incorrect: The exercise is not exclusive to Quad nations. It involves 19 allied and partner nations, including Brunei, Canada, Fiji, Finland, France, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Republic of Korea, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Thailand, and the UK, along with the Quad members.

Additional Information

  • The exercise will bring together more than 100 aircraft and personnel from the participating nations.
  • It is designed to enhance operational interoperability, strengthen military cooperation, and refine air combat tactics in realistic and complex scenarios.

Important Points

  • The exercise aims to strengthen regional interoperability across the Indo-Pacific.
  • Exercise Commander Air Commodore Matt McCormack stated that the drill is vital for the collective security and preparedness of Australia and the region.

questions.text: In which city in France was the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) recently launched at the Galeries Lafayette department store?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Nice

In News

  • India launched the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) at Galeries Lafayette, a famous department store in Nice, France.

Key Points

  • Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal launched the service at the Galeries Lafayette Nice Massena, located near the iconic Place Massena in Nice.
  • This initiative is part of UPI's global expansion and follows an earlier launch at the Eiffel Tower in Paris in early 2024.
  • The project involves the participation of Lyra Collect and NIPL (NPCI International Payments Limited) to provide seamless digital payment solutions.
  • The store in Nice offers over 600 brands across fashion, beauty, and lifestyle, making it a premier retail destination for Indian travellers to use the platform.
  • Therefore, the correct city is Nice, as specified in the news content regarding the latest launch at Galeries Lafayette.

Additional Information

  • With the addition of France, UPI is now accepted in nine countries: Singapore, UAE, France, Mauritius, Nepal, Bhutan, Qatar, Sri Lanka, and Cambodia.
  • The launch aims to strengthen economic and technological ties between India and France as part of their strategic partnership.

Important Points

  • UPI Global Footprint: Acceptance in major international markets allows Indian tourists to pay via familiar platforms without relying solely on foreign currency or cards.
  • Bilateral Cooperation: The partnership between India and France reflects growing ambitions in the digital economy and fintech sector.

questions.text: Which university recently became the first in India to be awarded four internationally recognized ISO Management System Certifications simultaneously by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Osmania University

In News

  • Osmania University, Hyderabad, has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first university in India to receive four internationally recognized ISO Management System Certifications simultaneously from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS).

Key Points

  • Osmania University: The institution was awarded these certifications in recognition of its commitment to quality, sustainability, and global management standards during its 109-year legacy.
  • Simultaneous Certifications: It is the first Indian university to be granted four specific ISO licences at once by the National Standards Body.
  • The Four Certifications include:
    • IS ISO 21001:2018: Educational Organizations Management System (EOMS).
    • IS ISO 14001:2015: Environmental Management System (EMS).
    • IS ISO 50001:2018: Energy Management System (EnMS).
    • IS ISO 22000:2018: Food Safety Management System (FSMS).
  • Presenter: The certificates were presented by Shri Sandeep Kumar Kanogia, Scientist-F and Deputy Director General (Southern Region), BIS.

Additional Information

  • Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS): It operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India.
  • Vice-Chancellor: Sr. Prof. Kumar Molugaram emphasized that these certifications reaffirm the university's commitment to being a future-ready and globally competitive institution.

Important Points

  • The evaluation process involved a rigorous and independent assessment of institutional policies, operational procedures, and internal audits.
  • These certifications act as a benchmark for excellence in higher education governance across the country.

questions.text: Who has been assigned the additional charge of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of UCO Bank in June 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rajendra Kumar Saboo

In News

  • Rajendra Kumar Saboo, the Executive Director of UCO Bank, has been assigned the additional charge of MD & CEO of the bank.

Key Points

  • The Department of Financial Services (DFS), under the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, issued the order for this additional charge.
  • Rajendra Kumar Saboo is currently serving as the Executive Director of UCO Bank.
  • The appointment follows the vacancy created after Ashwani Kumar completed his term as MD & CEO on May 31, 2026.
  • Saboo will hold the additional charge until August 31, 2026, or until a regular incumbent is appointed, or until further orders.

Additional Information

  • UCO Bank is a Kolkata-based public sector lender.
  • The announcement regarding the additional charge was made on Friday, June 21, 2026.

Important Points

  • Rajendra Kumar Saboo takes over the responsibilities from the former head, Ashwani Kumar.
  • The Ministry of Finance oversees the top-level appointments and additional charges in Public Sector Banks (PSBs) through the DFS.
